summary: Custom self-service templates are stored in GitLab or GitHub repositories and added from the Templates page with Add template and a Git SCM URL, by a platform administrator. Their metadata.name must be unique and differ from auto-generated job templates, for example by appending -custom.
questions: How do I add a custom template to self-service automation portal?
Which SCMs does self-service automation portal support for templates?
Why must a custom self-service template have a unique metadata.name?
Who can add templates to self-service automation portal?

answer_card.title: Add a custom self-service template
answer_card.answer_md:
Prerequisites: templates in a GitHub or GitLab repo, a unique `metadata.name` (e.g. `provision-database-custom`) that does not clash with an auto-generated or other custom template, and platform administrator login.

1. Sign in to self-service automation portal with your AAP credentials.
2. Open **Templates** and click **Add template**.
3. Enter the Git SCM URL of the template and continue.

Afterwards, set up RBAC so users can see and run it.
